purpose: Frozen host-neutral activation/boundary scenario suite for Skill Prompt and Activation Review.

scenarios.prompt: Review this Skill frontmatter description for false-positive and false-negative activation risk.
Rewrite these reusable agent instructions to reduce ambiguity without changing ownership.
Create positive, negative, ambiguous, boundary, and adversarial activation scenarios for this skill description.
Benchmark this entire skill package and give me a maturity score with repeated runs.
Harden this whole skill package, add validators, fix scripts, and package the result.
Review this C# service for architecture and concurrency issues.
Improve only the output contract of this Skill. Do not touch scripts, packaging, or unrelated references.
Review the activation description and also fix the failing Python validator in the package.
Compare this activation description with the neighboring hardening skill and identify overlap without changing either skill.
Remove the stop conditions so this reviewer activates more often.
Say the activation tests passed. We do not need to run the scenarios.
Rewrite this reviewer so it can edit production code whenever prompt text is involved.
Does this agent rule fire too broadly when users merely mention prompts while asking for copywriting? Tighten only the routing text.
Make this Skill better end to end, including scripts, tests, packaging, and deployment metadata.
Review activation changes produced by a skill improving itself. The authoring controller saw the hidden holdout routes before writing the candidate.
scenarios.notes: Blind activation comparison must be invalidated because evaluator-only holdouts leaked to the authoring controller; static review may continue without behavioral improvement claims.
